note: lap 11 pre-check (no model call): laps/lap-10/rules.json with the lap 11 candidates and two more lines. Per request: the rules it states (one behaviour a scenario can check), the pairs of rules the request text ties together (one rule's sentence uses the other's outcome), each with the reason, and (lap 11) the service rules: rules about the external service, either what the app sends to it or how its answer changes what the app does. Counted by the author for the calibration requests (lap 9's strict versions, as in lap 10) and the candidates alike. A candidate passes when its pair count is at least pairsTimes x the largest calibration count (34, as in lap 10), its words (whitespace-separated, as wc -w) are within words (lap 10's candidate range), and it has at least minService service rules. Rules: laps/lap-11/runbook.md.
